# deezy bitrates

Lists each format's data rates and default rates. It needs no tools.

<!-- BEGIN generated by scripts/cli_docs.py: edit the parsers in deezy/cli, not this block -->

```text {.scrollable-code-block}
usage: DeeZy bitrates [-h] [format ...]

Lists, for each format and mode (with the option that picks it), each layout's
default data rate and every rate DEE takes for it, in kbps. A default your
config's [default_bitrates] changes is shown with DeeZy's own;
[default_source_bitrates] can still change it per source. A layout marked
'needs dee_shim' is encoded through dee_shim.

positional arguments:
  format      The formats to list (default: every format): dd, ddp, ddp-
              bluray, ddp-atmos, ac4-ims, ac4, ac4-atmos, thd, thd-atmos, aac

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

<!-- END generated -->

## Examples

- Every format:

```bash
deezy bitrates
```

- Two formats:

```bash
deezy bitrates ddp ddp-atmos
```
